page_title: BOU 1-2 WOL | Bournemouth v Wolves 21/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Bournemouth have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+3' Bournemouth quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+1' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' It's a yellow card for Pedro Neto (Wolves).

88' 1 - 2 Goal! Hee-Chan Hwang displays great vision and sends a pass to Sasa Kalajdzic (Wolves), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:2.
86' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Craig Dawson (Wolves) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Neto easily catches the ball.
85' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Dominic Solanke as he is replaced by Kieffer Moore (Bournemouth).
85' The substitution has been made. Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) has replaced Milos Kerkez.
83' Paul Tierney shows a yellow card to Boubacar Traore (Wolves) for a tough tackle.
82' Here is a change. Matheus Cunha is going off and Gary O'Neil gives the last tactical orders to Sasa Kalajdzic (Wolves).

81' Pedro Neto (Wolves) gets on the end of a pass from Rayan Ait Nouri inside the box and quickly shoots, but the effort goes inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
79' The ball is cleared after Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
78' Wolves take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
78' Wolves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The referee blows his whistle, Wolves are awarded a corner kick.
78' A quickly taken corner by Wolves.
75' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) replaces Marcus Tavernier.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Toti trots off the pitch and is replaced by Pablo Sarabia (Wolves).

75' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
74' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Neto sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the left post.
73' Pedro Neto (Wolves) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
72' Wolves are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
70' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Jose Sa has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
67' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) flashes a header well wide of the left post following a lofted pass into the centre of the box.
65' Wolves force a corner. They send men into the box.
65' Wolves work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
63' A pass from Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is intercepted by Neto and the move breaks down.
60' A corner kick by Wolves is thwarted by the well prepared Neto (Bournemouth).
60' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. It will be a corner kick for Wolves.
57' Andoni Iraola decides to make a substitution. David Brooks will be replaced by Ryan Christie (Bournemouth).
57' Substitution. Alex Scott leaves the pitch and is replaced by Joe Rothwell (Bournemouth).
56' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
54' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Paul Tierney pulls out a yellow card.
54' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is banished from the pitch as he receives a red card.

53' Toti (Wolves) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Wolves.
52' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolves comes to nothing.
48' 1 - 1 Goal! Pedro Neto tees up Matheus Cunha (Wolves) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the right side of the goal. 1:1.
46' Substitution. Joao Gomes makes his way off the pitch and Thomas Doyle (Wolves) comes on as his replacement.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' The whistle blows and Max Kilman (Wolves) is booked for an infringement.
45+2' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Paul Tierney didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Craig Dawson (Wolves) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
42' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Paul Tierney's book.
40' The resulting set piece from Wolves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
39' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolves. Wolves force their opponents to concede a corner.
38' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
38' Bournemouth quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
37' Joao Gomes (Wolves) commits a rough challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul. Bournemouth win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
35' Pedro Neto (Wolves) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
34' Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) sees a yellow card from Paul Tierney after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

33' Pedro Neto (Wolves) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
31' Paul Tierney blows his whistle. Lloyd Kelly (Bournemouth) commits a foul after dangerous play.
30' Wolves take a short corner kick.

29' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. Wolves will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
28' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jose Sa intercepts the ball.
28' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.

26' Joao Gomes (Wolves) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Paul Tierney stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Free kick. Bournemouth will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
25' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
17' 1 - 0 GOAL! Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) finishes off a sublime move with a delightful back-heel goal. Philip Billing provided the assist with a brilliant pass. 1:0.
14' Wolves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

14' Boubacar Traore (Wolves) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Wolves.
13' Good movement by Pedro Neto (Wolves), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
12' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
9' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
7' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Paul Tierney no option but to blow his whistle.
5' Pedro Neto (Wolves) gets a shot from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar!
5' David Brooks (Bournemouth) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Jose Sa is alert and denies him.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Bournemouth will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Paul Tierney.
